prompt_en: A complex photographic scene centers a human subject in a visible physical state, with face-and-hair guidance drawn from the supplied portrait. The newly portrayed person is a 28-year-old adult stage designer pausing just after unrolling a new backdrop beside a canal lock. A traveling shadow-theatre truck has opened its side into a small rehearsal stage. She sits squarely on the broad padded top of a low road case, where the seated body meets a coherent support area on the soft cushion; a small cushion depression is localized beneath the load. At the pad edge, the clothing folds follow the seated contact without penetrating the seat. Her thighs angle upward and outward from that pelvis to two clearly separated raised, bent knees; each shin descends to its own work boot, both soles flat on the wet quay. The uninterrupted leg chain reads as an M from this frontal view: left boot, raised outward left knee, low seated pelvis, raised outward right knee, right boot. Both complete legs and the seat contact remain clearly visible. Across her upper arms, midsection, hip sides, thighs and calves, multiple body regions share the build relation. Her work top follows substantial continuous soft torso volume; warm form light models full upper-arm and thigh volume. Her visible waist contour remains distinct within the continuous soft volume. A close-fitting russet short-sleeve jersey work top and olive stretch-twill trousers follow this continuous volume. Her chin-length dark bob has wispy bangs; broad dark eyes and softly parted pink lips echo the visible portrait guidance. One forearm rests easily beside her on the case while the other hand loosely holds the backdrop cord at her side. A folded tracing-paper projection mask lies on a side worktable. The curled leading edge of the newly unrolled fabric hangs behind her. Rain-cleared twilight cools the canal beyond; warm rehearsal lamps reveal the fabric weave, rounded body contours and small wet reflections. A front-facing full-body view at knee height holds the connected leg silhouette, seat and both boot contacts within a spacious vertical frame.
